fields.name: DashSpell
fields.evidence: FindSpellsSystem::Update: SpellId::operator=(+0x70) next to ls::Optional<esv::ai::swarm::DashSpell>::Get (spells of type 6 with an AI flag).

fields.name: DashMovementPoints
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x16B2960 FindSpellsSystem::Update stores here the double of the ls::Optional<esv::ai::swarm::DashSpell> that FindSpellsSystemHelper slot 3 (EoCServer.dll+0x16B0DD0) returns for the spell it puts in DashSpell (+0x70). Slot 3 runs the spell's functors in a prepared context and returns eoc::action_resource::GetResourceValue(Movement) afterwards, only when it is above the value before: the movement the character has after dashing. Live 16.8 / -1.0.

fields.name: MoveSpellMovementCost
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x16B2960 esv::ai::swarm::FindSpellsSystem::Update stores here, for a spell eoc::spell::IsMovementSpell accepts, the result of FindSpellsSystemHelper vtable slot 1 (vtable slots 0x23D290, 0x16B0D20, 0x16B1BA0, 0x16B0DD0); slot 1, EoCServer.dll+0x16B0D20, returns eoc::action_resource::GetMovementCost of eoc::SpellPrototype::GetTotalCosts for that spell. Live 0 / 3.0.
